text:
Alex: heads up — saw a ~35% p95 latency regression after onboarding mixtralX via the safetensors conversion. Canary shows a lot more memcpy and a kernel fallback path being used.
Priya: saw the same. ran a quick perf on a single-worker canary. flamegraph: https://ci.internal/redwood/flame/mixtralX-2813.svg — big red block in "generic_attention" not "optimized_rope".
Marco: digging into the converted weights: safetensors metadata missing the metadata key we rely on: "num_key_value_heads". HF config had head counts in separate field and our converter didn't synthesize the kv-heads metadata. leads to head_dim != kv_dim check failing -> runtime chooses generic kernel.
Zoe: that mismatch will trigger the safer kernel path. also noticed the metadata lacked rotary_pct/rope_scaling entries for this shard which forces default RoPE handling. both together explain perf + correctness risk.
Alex: quick repro command I ran:
```
python tools/convert_safetensors.py \
  --input s3://models/mixtralX/model.safetensors \
  --output /tmp/mixtralX.conv.safetensors \
  --ensure-meta num_key_value_heads=32 --ensure-meta rope_scaling=0.7
```
Priya: profiling snippet (canary run, 8k tokens):
```
[profile] memcpy_bytes: 1.2GB
[profile] generic_attention_cycles: 7.4e8
[profile] optimized_attention_cycles: 1.9e8
[metric] p95_before: 210ms
[metric] p95_after_meta_fix: 145ms
```
Marco: root cause == converter not mapping HF 'num_kv_heads' / 'kv_head_count' variants into our canonical "num_key_value_heads" metadata. also some models encode rotary params differently -> rope_scale missing.
Zoe: triage plan: 1) small converter patch to synthesize num_key_value_heads and rope_scaling from common HF names, with test vectors; 2) runtime: temporarily relax kernel-selection strictness to allow optimized kernel if head_dim * num_heads matches within tolerance, and reduce prefetch/batch window to avoid KV memcpy spikes; 3) run 3-stage canary (perf, correctness, A/B).
Alex: agree. Marco, can you own converter PR? Priya I'll own the runtime heuristic change and perf validation. Zoe do the canary rollout plan?
Marco: yes, will open PR today. converter unit test added. example diff will write metadata into safetensors header.
Priya: runtime PR: change kernel_cost_estimator to prefer optimized_rope when abs(kv_dim - head_dim) < 2 and num_kv_heads > 0. Also temporary batcher tweak: max_batch_window_ms = max(20, current-30). will include perf numbers.
Zoe: I'll coordinate canary windows and add prompt sets for regressions. plan: 50 QPS -> 200 QPS -> full route over 24h if stable.
deploy-bot: CI passed for branch pr/1132 (converter) and pr/1133 (runtime heuristics) — builds 8421 and 8422. :white_check_mark:
Alex: good. action items recorded. postmortem-style summary after 48h canary. thanks folks :thumbsup:
Priya: one more note — add a lint rule to the onboarding checklist that fails if safetensors metadata lacks either num_key_value_heads or explicit kv_head aliases. simple grep in conversion pipeline.
Marco: will add that to PR.
Zoe: tagging @eng-platform to watch for rollout impact on Dedicated pools.
Alex: closing thread once both PRs merged and first canary stage ok.
